rootstocks.name: detect_pick
rootstocks.description: Canonical detect-gated manipulation pattern for direct pick tasks.
rootstocks.when_to_use: Use when the task is to go to one location, verify the target object, and pick it.
rootstocks.anti_pattern: Do not pick before detect succeeds.

slots.name: source_location
slots.description: Location or object spawn to navigate to before detect and pick.

slots.name: open_before_detect
slots.description: Set true when the source location can be closed, such as pantry or fridge.

rootstocks.name: search_pick_selector
rootstocks.description: Two-branch selector search pattern with a guarded detect-and-pick branch at each location.
rootstocks.when_to_use: Use when the task says to search one location, then fall back to a second location, and pick the object if found.
rootstocks.anti_pattern: Do not make the fallback branch a blind navigate-and-pick sequence.

rootstocks.name: search_pick_deliver
rootstocks.description: Search with selector fallback, then continue to a delivery step such as place or return.
rootstocks.when_to_use: Use when the task says to search across candidate locations and then either place the object somewhere or return to a destination while holding it.
rootstocks.anti_pattern: Do not put delivery actions inside only one selector branch.

panther_gemma_mcore.prompt: Task 14: Go to the NRG entrance and then wait for a person to arrive. If you don't see one for 1 minute, slowly pan back and forth until you see a person. When you see one, face them, drive forward 1 meter to greet them, and wait 5 seconds. Then go to the vending machine, then the kitchen entrance, and finally return to NRG entrance and start the process all over again.
panther_gemma_mcore.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
      <ReactiveFallback>
        <ReactiveSequence name="face_person_reactive">
          <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
          <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
            <HeadingController class_name="person" timeout="0.0" detection_loss_timeout="1.0"/>
          </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
        </ReactiveSequence>
        <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
          <SequenceWithMemory name="hallway_patrol">
            <NavigateToLocation location="nrg_entrance"/>
            <NavigateToLocation location="mid_hallway"/>
            <NavigateToLocation location="between_hallways"/>
            <NavigateToLocation location="kitchen_entrance"/>
          </SequenceWithMemory>
        </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
      </ReactiveFallback>
    </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
  </BehaviorTree>
  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

panther_sonnet_mcore.prompt: Head to the vending machine, but stop immediately if you detect a person. Once they are gone, wait 10 seconds, and then resume going to the vending machine. Once you've reached it, come back to the nrg entrance.
panther_sonnet_mcore.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <Sequence name="mission">

      <!-- Navigate to vending_machine with reactive person-detection interrupt -->
      <!-- On detection: stop nav, wait for person to leave, wait 10s, resume -->
      <RetryUntilSuccessful num_attempts="100" name="nav_to_vending_machine">
        <Sequence name="nav_attempt">

          <!-- Pre-check: if a person is currently detected, wait for them to leave then wait 10s -->
          <ForceSuccess name="handle_person_if_present">
            <Sequence name="person_handling">
              <!-- Only enters if person is currently seen -->
              <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" name="check_person_present"/>
              <!-- Wait until person leaves (CheckDetection drops to FAILURE) -->
              <ReactiveFallback name="wait_until_person_gone">
                <Inverter>
                  <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" name="check_person_gone"/>
                </Inverter>
                <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
                  <Wait wait_duration="1.0" name="polling_wait"/>
                </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
              </ReactiveFallback>
              <!-- Wait an additional 10 seconds after person has left -->
              <Wait wait_duration="10.0" name="wait_10_seconds"/>
            </Sequence>
          </ForceSuccess>

          <!-- Navigate to vending_machine; halt immediately if person detected -->
          <ReactiveSequence name="guarded_nav">
            <!-- Guard: succeeds only when NO person is detected -->
            <Inverter>
              <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" name="check_no_person"/>
            </Inverter>
            <NavigateToLocation location="vending_machine" name="go_to_vending_machine"/>
          </ReactiveSequence>

        </Sequence>
      </RetryUntilSuccessful>

      <!-- Return to NRG entrance after reaching vending machine -->
      <NavigateToLocation location="nrg_entrance" name="return_to_nrg"/>

    </Sequence>
  </BehaviorTree>
  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="Wait">
      <input_port name="wait_duration"/>
    </Action>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

          <Sequence name="recover_and_attempt_2">
            <ForceSuccess>
              <BackUp name="backup_1" backup_dist="0.5" backup_speed="0.1"/>

            <Wait name="wait_1" wait_duration="3.0"/>
            <NavigateToLocation name="attempt_2" location="elevator"/>

            <NavigateToLocation name="attempt_3" location="elevator"/>
          </Sequence>

      </ForceSuccess>
      <NavigateToLocation name="return_home" location="nrg_entrance"/>

    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>

</root>

panther_sonnet_mcore.prompt: Task 12: Patrol the hallway. When you see a person, stop and face them, then resume patrolling.
panther_sonnet_mcore.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <!-- Outer KRUF: keeps the entire mission running indefinitely -->
    <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
      <ReactiveFallback>

        <!-- Branch 1: person detected → stop patrol and face them -->
        <!-- ReactiveSequence: CheckDetection guards HeadingController every tick.
             When person leaves, CheckDetection→FAILURE halts HeadingController
             and ReactiveFallback falls through to resume patrol. -->
        <ReactiveSequence name="face_if_person">
          <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
          <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
            <HeadingController class_name="person" timeout="0.0" detection_loss_timeout="1.0"/>
          </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
        </ReactiveSequence>

        <!-- Branch 2: no person → patrol the hallway waypoints.
             SequenceWithMemory resumes from the interrupted waypoint
             (not from mid_hallway) after a detection event. -->
        <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
          <SequenceWithMemory name="patrol_loop">
            <NavigateToLocation location="mid_hallway"/>
            <NavigateToLocation location="between_hallways"/>
            <NavigateToLocation location="bottom_of_staircase"/>
          </SequenceWithMemory>
        </KeepRunningUntilFailure>

      </ReactiveFallback>
    </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
  </BehaviorTree>

  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

panther_sonnet_mcore.prompt: Patrol continuously between the NRG entrance, mid hallway, between hallways, and kitchen entrance. Whenever you spot a person, stop and face them until they are out of frame. Then resume patrolling. Keep going indefinitely.
panther_sonnet_mcore.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <!-- Outer KRUF: absorbs all FAILUREs so the mission never terminates -->
    <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="run_forever">
      <ReactiveFallback name="patrol_or_face">

        <!-- Branch 1 (high priority): person detected → face them continuously -->
        <!-- ReactiveSequence: CheckDetection guards HeadingController every tick.
             When person leaves, CheckDetection → FAILURE halts the tracker.
             ReactiveSequence → FAILURE falls through to patrol branch. -->
        <ReactiveSequence name="face_if_person">
          <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
          <!-- KRUF converts each HeadingController SUCCESS (aligned) back to RUNNING so
               tracking keeps looping. Detection-loss FAILURE exits naturally. -->
          <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="keep_facing">
            <HeadingController class_name="person" timeout="0.0" detection_loss_timeout="1.0"/>
          </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
        </ReactiveSequence>

        <!-- Branch 2 (default): patrol indefinitely through all 4 waypoints.
             SequenceWithMemory preserves the current waypoint index across interruptions,
             so patrol resumes from the halted leg — not from nrg_entrance every time. -->
        <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="keep_patrolling">
          <SequenceWithMemory name="patrol_loop">
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_nrg_entrance"    location="nrg_entrance"/>
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_mid_hallway"     location="mid_hallway"/>
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_between_hallways" location="between_hallways"/>
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_kitchen_entrance" location="kitchen_entrance"/>
          </SequenceWithMemory>
        </KeepRunningUntilFailure>

      </ReactiveFallback>
    </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
  </BehaviorTree>

  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

panther_sonnet_mcore.prompt: Go to the NRG entrance and then wait for a person to arrive. If you don't see one for 1 minute, slowly pan back and forth until you see a person. When you see one, face them, drive forward 1 meter to greet them, and wait 5 seconds. Then go to the vending machine, then the kitchen entrance, and finally return to NRG entrance and start the process all over again.
panther_sonnet_mcore.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">

    <!-- Infinite greeter loop: NRG → wait/sweep for person → greet → tour → repeat -->
    <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="infinite_greeter_loop">
      <Sequence name="greeter_cycle">

        <!-- 1. Navigate to NRG entrance -->
        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_nrg_entrance" location="nrg_entrance"/>

        <!-- 2. Wait up to 60 s for a person; if none, sweep slowly until one appears -->
        <Fallback name="detect_person">

          <!-- 2a. Stationary wait — up to 60 seconds -->
          <WaitForDetection name="wait_for_person_60s" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" timeout="60.0"/>

          <!-- 2b. Timeout hit — slowly pan until person detected -->
          <ReactiveFallback name="sweep_until_person">
            <CheckDetection name="check_person_during_sweep" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5"/>
            <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="continuous_pan">
              <Spin name="slow_pan" target_yaw="6.28" time_allowance="30.0"/>
            </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
          </ReactiveFallback>

        </Fallback>

        <!-- 3. Greet: face person → drive 1 m → wait 5 s
             ForceSuccess ensures the cycle continues even if person leaves mid-greeting -->
        <ForceSuccess>
          <Sequence name="greet_sequence">
            <HeadingController name="face_person" class_name="person" timeout="5.0" detection_loss_timeout="2.0"/>
            <MoveForward name="approach_1m" forward_dist="1.0"/>
            <Wait name="greet_pause_5s" wait_duration="5.0"/>
          </Sequence>
        </ForceSuccess>

        <!-- 4. Tour: vending machine → kitchen entrance -->
        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_vending_machine" location="vending_machine"/>
        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_kitchen_entrance" location="kitchen_entrance"/>

        <!-- Sequence SUCCESS → KRUF converts to RUNNING → restarts from nrg_entrance -->

      </Sequence>
    </KeepRunningUntilFailure>

  </BehaviorTree>
  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="WaitForDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="Spin">
      <input_port name="target_yaw"/>
      <input_port name="time_allowance"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="MoveForward">
      <input_port name="forward_dist"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="Wait">

        </ReactiveSequence>
        <Sequence>
          <Spin target_yaw="6.28" time_allowance="10.0"/>

  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>

    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="Spin">
      <input_port name="target_yaw"/>
      <input_port name="time_allowance"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="Wait">
      <input_port name="wait_duration"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <Sequence>
      <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
        <ReactiveFallback>
          <Sequence>
            <CheckDetection class_name="person"/>
            <ForceSuccess>
              <Repeat num_cycles="-1">
                <CheckDetection class_name="person"/>
                <Wait wait_duration="1.0"/>
              </Repeat>
            </ForceSuccess>
            <Wait wait_duration="10.0"/>
          </Sequence>
          <Inverter>
            <NavigateToLocation location="vending_machine"/>
          </Inverter>
        </ReactiveFallback>
      </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
      <NavigateToLocation location="nrg_entrance"/>
    </Sequence>
  </BehaviorTree>
  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="Wait">
      <input_port name="wait_duration"/>
    </Action>

            <Inverter>
              <CheckDetection class_name="person"/>

          <Wait wait_duration="10.0"/>
          <ForceFailure>
            <AlwaysSuccess/>
          </ForceFailure>

      </ReactiveFallback>
      <NavigateToLocation location="nrg_entrance"/>

      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="AlwaysSuccess"/>
  </TreeNodesModel>

panther_gemma_b1.prompt: Go to the NRG entrance and then wait for a person to arrive. If you don't see one for 1 minute, slowly pan back and forth until you see a person. When you see one, face them, drive forward 1 meter to greet them, and wait 5 seconds. Then go to the vending machine, then the kitchen entrance, and finally return to NRG entrance and start the process all over again.
panther_gemma_b1.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <ReactiveFallback>
      <ReactiveSequence name="face_person_reactive">
        <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5"/>
        <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
          <HeadingController class_name="person" timeout="0.0" detection_loss_timeout="1.0"/>
        </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
      </ReactiveSequence>
      <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
        <SequenceWithMemory name="hallway_patrol">
          <NavigateToLocation location="nrg_entrance"/>
          <NavigateToLocation location="mid_hallway"/>
          <NavigateToLocation location="between_hallways"/>
        </SequenceWithMemory>
      </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
    </ReactiveFallback>
  </BehaviorTree>
  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

panther_sonnet_b1.prompt: Wait here until you see a person. Sweep the space periodically. When you see someone, face them until they go out of frame, then continue waiting here.
panther_sonnet_b1.bt_xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <!-- Outer ReactiveFallback: face person if visible, else sweep periodically -->
    <ReactiveFallback name="watch_and_sweep">

      <!-- Branch 1: Person visible → continuously face them until out of frame -->
      <ReactiveSequence name="face_if_person">
        <CheckDetection name="check_person" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
        <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="track_while_visible">
          <HeadingController name="face_person" class_name="person" timeout="0.0" detection_loss_timeout="1.5"/>
        </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
      </ReactiveSequence>

      <!-- Branch 2: No person → wait then do a 360° sweep, repeat indefinitely -->
      <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="sweep_loop">
        <Sequence name="wait_then_sweep">
          <Wait name="idle_pause" wait_duration="8.0"/>
          <Spin name="full_sweep" target_yaw="6.28" time_allowance="20.0"/>
        </Sequence>
      </KeepRunningUntilFailure>

    </ReactiveFallback>
  </BehaviorTree>

  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="Wait">
      <input_port name="wait_duration"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="Spin">
      <input_port name="target_yaw"/>
      <input_port name="time_allowance"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

      <ReactiveSequence name="face_if_person">
        <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="1.0"/>

          <HeadingController class_name="person" timeout="0.0" detection_loss_timeout="1.0"/>

      </ReactiveSequence>

      <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
        <SequenceWithMemory name="patrol_loop">
          <NavigateToLocation location="mid_hallway"/>
          <NavigateToLocation location="between_hallways"/>
        </SequenceWithMemory>
      </KeepRunningUntilFailure>

    </ReactiveFallback>
  </BehaviorTree>

    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>

      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <!-- Outer KRUF: keeps the reactive loop running indefinitely -->
    <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="run_forever">
      <ReactiveFallback name="face_or_idle">

        <!-- Branch 1: Person visible → face them continuously -->
        <ReactiveSequence name="face_if_person">
          <!-- Condition: is a person currently in view? -->
          <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
          <!-- Keep re-aligning: SUCCESS→RUNNING so tracking never stops mid-person -->
          <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="keep_facing">
            <HeadingController class_name="person" timeout="0.0" detection_loss_timeout="1.0"/>
          </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
        </ReactiveSequence>

        <!-- Branch 2: No person → idle (continue behavior) -->
        <AlwaysSuccess name="idle"/>

      </ReactiveFallback>
    </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
  </BehaviorTree>
  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

panther_sonnet_b1.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <Sequence name="main_mission">

      <!-- Phase 1: Navigate to vending_machine, stop immediately if person detected,
           wait for them to leave, wait 10s, then resume -->
      <RetryUntilSuccessful num_attempts="1000">
        <Fallback name="nav_or_handle_person">

          <!-- Navigate to vending_machine; abort the instant a person is detected -->
          <ReactiveSequence name="nav_with_person_check">
            <Inverter>
              <CheckDetection name="watch_for_person" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
            </Inverter>
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_vending" location="vending_machine"/>
          </ReactiveSequence>

          <!-- Person was detected: wait until they leave, wait 10s, then force retry -->
          <ForceFailure>
            <Sequence name="handle_person_detected">
              <!-- Block until person leaves the frame -->
              <ReactiveFallback name="wait_for_person_gone">
                <Inverter>
                  <CheckDetection name="check_person_present" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
                </Inverter>
                <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
                  <Wait name="poll_wait" wait_duration="0.5"/>
                </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
              </ReactiveFallback>
              <!-- Wait 10 seconds before resuming -->
              <Wait name="wait_10s" wait_duration="10.0"/>
            </Sequence>
          </ForceFailure>

        </Fallback>
      </RetryUntilSuccessful>

      <!-- Phase 2: Return to NRG entrance -->
      <NavigateToLocation name="return_to_nrg" location="nrg_entrance"/>

    </Sequence>
  </BehaviorTree>
  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="Wait">
      <input_port name="wait_duration"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

panther_sonnet_b1.prompt: Try to go to the elevator. If navigation fails, back up safely, wait for a bit, and then try again. After you've tried 3 times, come back to the nrg entrance.
panther_sonnet_b1.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <Sequence name="main">

      <!-- Up to 3 elevator attempts; ForceSuccess ensures we always proceed home -->
      <ForceSuccess name="attempt_block">
        <Fallback name="try_3_times">

          <!-- Attempt 1 -->
          <NavigateToLocation name="nav_elevator_1" location="elevator"/>

          <!-- Attempt 1 failed: recover, then make attempts 2 and 3 -->
          <Sequence name="recover_and_retry_from_1">
            <BackUp name="backup_1" backup_dist="0.5" backup_speed="0.1"/>
            <Wait name="wait_1" wait_duration="5.0"/>

            <Fallback name="try_2_and_3">

              <!-- Attempt 2 -->
              <NavigateToLocation name="nav_elevator_2" location="elevator"/>

              <!-- Attempt 2 failed: recover, then make final attempt 3 -->
              <Sequence name="recover_and_retry_from_2">
                <BackUp name="backup_2" backup_dist="0.5" backup_speed="0.1"/>
                <Wait name="wait_2" wait_duration="5.0"/>

                <!-- Attempt 3 (last); success or failure both caught by ForceSuccess above -->
                <NavigateToLocation name="nav_elevator_3" location="elevator"/>
              </Sequence>

            </Fallback>
          </Sequence>

        </Fallback>
      </ForceSuccess>

      <!-- Always return to NRG entrance after all attempts -->
      <NavigateToLocation name="return_home" location="nrg_entrance"/>

    </Sequence>
  </BehaviorTree>

  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="BackUp">
      <input_port name="backup_dist"/>
      <input_port name="backup_speed"/>
      <input_port name="time_allowance"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="Wait">
      <input_port name="wait_duration"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

panther_sonnet_b1.prompt: Patrol the hallway. When you see a person, stop and face them, then resume patrolling.
panther_sonnet_b1.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <!-- Top-level reactive loop: face person when seen, otherwise patrol -->
    <ReactiveFallback name="patrol_with_person_interrupt">

      <!-- Branch 1 (priority): detect person → face until lost, then fall through -->
      <ReactiveSequence name="face_if_person">
        <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
        <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
          <HeadingController class_name="person" timeout="0.0" detection_loss_timeout="1.0"/>
        </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
      </ReactiveSequence>

      <!-- Branch 2 (default): patrol hallway continuously -->
      <KeepRunningUntilFailure>
        <SequenceWithMemory name="patrol_loop">
          <NavigateToLocation location="mid_hallway"/>
          <NavigateToLocation location="between_hallways"/>
        </SequenceWithMemory>
      </KeepRunningUntilFailure>

    </ReactiveFallback>
  </BehaviorTree>

  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>

panther_sonnet_b1.prompt: Patrol continuously between the NRG entrance, mid hallway, between hallways, and kitchen entrance. Whenever you spot a person, stop and face them until they are out of frame. Then resume patrolling. Keep going indefinitely.
panther_sonnet_b1.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="infinite_mission">
      <ReactiveFallback name="patrol_or_face">

        <!-- Branch 1: Stop and face any person detected -->
        <ReactiveSequence name="face_if_person">
          <CheckDetection class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
          <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="keep_facing">
            <HeadingController class_name="person" timeout="0.0" detection_loss_timeout="1.0"/>
          </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
        </ReactiveSequence>

        <!-- Branch 2: Patrol continuously (resumes from interrupted waypoint) -->
        <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="loop_patrol">
          <SequenceWithMemory name="patrol_loop">
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_nrg_entrance"    location="nrg_entrance"/>
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_mid_hallway"     location="mid_hallway"/>
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_between_hallways" location="between_hallways"/>
            <NavigateToLocation name="go_kitchen_entrance" location="kitchen_entrance"/>
          </SequenceWithMemory>
        </KeepRunningUntilFailure>

      </ReactiveFallback>
    </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
  </BehaviorTree>

  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>

panther_sonnet_b1.prompt: Go to the NRG entrance and then wait for a person to arrive. If you don't see one for 1 minute, slowly pan back and forth until you see a person. When you see one, face them, drive forward 1 meter to greet them, and wait 5 seconds. Then go to the vending machine, then the kitchen entrance, and finally return to NRG entrance and start the process all over again.
panther_sonnet_b1.bt_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="infinite_greeter_loop">
      <Sequence name="greeter_cycle">

        <!-- Step 1: Go to NRG entrance to begin/restart the greeting cycle -->
        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_nrg" location="nrg_entrance"/>

        <!-- Step 2: Wait up to 60 s for a person.
             If timeout fires (FAILURE), fall through to panning loop. -->
        <Fallback name="detect_person">
          <WaitForDetection name="wait_60s" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" timeout="60.0"/>
          <!-- Pan back and forth slowly until a person is spotted -->
          <ReactiveFallback name="pan_until_person">
            <CheckDetection name="check_person_during_pan" class_name="person" min_confidence="0.5" max_age="2.0"/>
            <KeepRunningUntilFailure name="keep_panning">
              <Spin name="pan_sweep" target_yaw="3.14" time_allowance="15.0"/>
            </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
          </ReactiveFallback>
        </Fallback>

        <!-- Step 3: Face person, drive 1 m forward, wait 5 s.
             Wrapped in Fallback so a lost detection lets the cycle continue. -->
        <Fallback name="greet_or_continue">
          <Sequence name="greeting">
            <HeadingController name="face_person" class_name="person" detection_loss_timeout="2.0"/>
            <MoveForward name="approach_1m" forward_dist="1.0"/>
            <Wait name="greet_pause" wait_duration="5.0"/>
          </Sequence>
          <AlwaysSuccess/>
        </Fallback>

        <!-- Steps 4–5: Route to vending machine, then kitchen entrance -->
        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_vending" location="vending_machine"/>
        <NavigateToLocation name="go_to_kitchen" location="kitchen_entrance"/>

        <!-- Sequence SUCCESS → KRUF converts to RUNNING → restarts from nrg_entrance -->
      </Sequence>
    </KeepRunningUntilFailure>
  </BehaviorTree>

  <TreeNodesModel>
    <Action ID="NavigateToLocation">
      <input_port name="location"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="WaitForDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Condition ID="CheckDetection">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="min_confidence"/>
      <input_port name="max_age"/>
    </Condition>
    <Action ID="Spin">
      <input_port name="target_yaw"/>
      <input_port name="time_allowance"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="HeadingController">
      <input_port name="class_name"/>
      <input_port name="detection_loss_timeout"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="MoveForward">
      <input_port name="forward_dist"/>
    </Action>
    <Action ID="Wait">
      <input_port name="wait_duration"/>
    </Action>
  </TreeNodesModel>
</root>
